title: [main] Bug 647499 Bin Replenishment with Pick by FEFO Creates Incorrect Inventory Movements
summary: Fixed bin replenishment with FEFO-based picking to correctly calculate quantities and clear processed worksheet lines in basic warehouse locations.
key_points: FEFO inventory movements now exclude the destination bin when calculating available quantity to pick, ensuring correct lot selection and full quantity fulfillment
Handled warehouse activity buffers for FEFO movements are now recorded with blank From Bin to match worksheet lines and enable proper deletion of processed lines
Prevents incorrect inventory movements and unprocessed worksheet lines that occurred when the earliest FEFO lot was already in the replenishment bin
quote: Bin Replenishment with Pick by FEFO Creates Incorrect Inventory Movements and Leaves Movement Worksheet Lines Unprocessed
